body:
## Gap

Both browser-websocket end-to-end tests in pkgs/id (`src/web/world_ws.rs` — upload-a-module and compile-from-source) use the Screen roc-counter, since #565 migrated that example to `pf.Screen`. The legacy text presentation — a program that never imports Screen and returns plain UTF-8 text (`src/world_presentation.rs`: "Legacy UTF-8 text remains valid") — is covered only at unit level. There is no end-to-end proof that a no-Screen world works over the browser socket. Recorded in `doc/2026-10-31T17-47-20Z_design_world_presentation_and_fuel/` (testing state section).

## Wanted

- A small text-only example program (no Screen import — e.g. a line-oriented counter whose view is plain text), checked in under `pkgs/id/examples`, with fuel baselines/budgets for its call kinds in the `src/sandbox.rs` table like every other checked-in example.
- End-to-end tests over the browser websocket, in the style of the two existing `world_ws` tests:
  - (a) upload the prebuilt module and run it: snapshot/event frames carry the plain text;
  - (b) compile from source in a world whose capability ceiling **excludes** Screen: compilation succeeds (there is nothing to grant) and the run works — proving no-Screen worlds are first-class over the socket.

Keep the example minimal: it exists to keep the text path covered, not to grow a second UI surface. The line/teletype presentation tiers are #786's design space; this issue covers only today's legacy text path.

## Acceptance

- The new tests pass in the pkgs/id lib suite and in the nix build check phase.
- The text-only example appears in the fuel budget table with measured baselines.

---
Program: Drew's 2026-10-28 directive (full text: hatch-personal `memory/topics/id-program-2026-10-28.md`).
Working pattern: parallel investigations, then the named synthesis issue merges them into a full design. Route guidance: Workhorse by default; Specialist/Summit for synthesis and ramification-heavy work. A result that says "done" is not the endpoint — the orchestrator reviews it and may commission another round. Deliverables: a markdown design/investigation doc (mermaid/SVG diagrams welcome) linked from this issue, plus follow-up issues for anything buildable. Build a proof of concept where the design calls for one, but do NOT build the permanent feature on top of an unreviewed PoC.


## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A minimal text-only example program (no Screen import) is checked in under `pkgs/id/examples`, with fuel baselines/budgets for its call kinds in the `src/sandbox.rs` table.
- [ ] Browser-websocket end-to-end test (a): uploading the prebuilt text-only module and running it yields snapshot/event frames carrying the plain text.
- [ ] Browser-websocket end-to-end test (b): compiling the text-only program from source in a world whose capability ceiling excludes Screen succeeds and the run works.
- [ ] The new tests pass in the pkgs/id lib suite and in the nix build check phase.
